_help: Fix names and matches. "names": a game's name as PlayStation gives it -> the name to show (use it when a store name comes through translated). Top level: game name as shown -> RAWG slug (last part of its rawg.io/games/... URL), or null for no Metacritic score. "hltb": game name as shown -> the title to search on HowLongToBeat. "metacritic": game name as shown -> a score you enter yourself.
